Body.Content:
This feature provides a shared payment service on Microsoft Dataverse that organisations can integrate into Dynamics 365 business workflows. Scenarios include collecting payments for invoices, sales orders, and work orders in supported applications.

Applications can use common payment APIs to authorize, capture, void, and refund terminal payments through cloud-connected payment terminals. Administrators select a payment connector and configure its merchant settings through connector profiles.

The service includes built-in Adyen support. Partners can add payment connectors through extension solutions without changing the core service or adding new payment APIs. Each customer's service and payment configuration reside in that customer's Dataverse environment.

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
